source.manualTitle: Whirlpool Modular Ice Maker Service Sheet (Part 2225623, 120 V)
source.oemTestTitle: Water valve voltage and fill specification

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the refrigerator or disconnect power before resistance checks or module removal. Restore power only for live voltage checks when required.
steps.sourceExcerpt: MODULE OHMMETER CHECKS (no power; ejector blades in PARK).

steps.title: Prepare for fill test
steps.body: Test points L, N, M, T, H, V are stamped on the circuit module (3 Phillips removal screws). Pull water-adjust knob and snap off cover for access. Ejector blades must be in park for resistance tests. Do not manually start the cycle — initiate electrically only. Align "D" coupling on reinstall. Confirm water supply ON and fill tube clear. Initiate cycle electrically only.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Test points L, N, M, T, H, V are stamped on the circuit module (3 Phillips removal screws). Pull water-adjust knob and snap off cover for access. Ejector blades must be in park for resistance tests. Do not manually start the cycle — initiate electrically only. Align "D" coupling on reinstall. Confirm water supply ON and fill tube clear. Initiate cycle electrically only.

steps.title: N–V valve voltage during fill?
steps.body: During water-fill phase: N–V line voltage = valve ON; 0 V = OFF.
steps.sourceExcerpt: During water-fill phase: N–V line voltage = valve ON; 0 V = OFF.

branches.label: No / fault
branches.oemOutcome: No N–V voltage during fill — module, harness, or cabinet valve path.

steps.title: Fill volume ~140 cc / 7.5 sec?
steps.body: Measure fill: specification is 140 cc in 7.5 seconds. Under-fill causes small or hollow cubes.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Measure fill: specification is 140 cc in 7.5 seconds. Under-fill causes small or hollow cubes.

branches.label: No / fault
branches.oemOutcome: Under-fill — check water pressure, filter, fill tube freeze, and adjustment.

steps.title: Valve or module fault
steps.oemOutcome: No fill voltage at N–V — trace valve, harness, and module (IME4/E4 dry cycle).

steps.title: Adjust fill or repair supply
steps.oemOutcome: Fill below 140 cc/7.5 s — check pressure, filter, fill tube; adjust fill screw.

steps.title: Water fill verified
steps.oemOutcome: N–V valve voltage and 140 cc / 7.5 s fill verified.
